external_entities.name: Duty engineer
external_entities.description: An engineer who uses the dispatch console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Duty engineers sit on the corporate network.
external_entities.notes: Authentication to the dispatch console is not recorded.

external_entities.name: Scheduling partner
external_entities.description: Another company that publishes tomorrow's planned work.
external_entities.source_excerpt: A scheduling partner, which is another company, publishes tomorrow's planned work.

processes.name: Corporate web host
processes.description: The corporate web host serves the dispatch console.
processes.source_excerpt: our corporate web host serves it

processes.name: Dispatch console
processes.description: A single-page JavaScript application used by duty engineers to operate the field dispatch platform.
processes.source_excerpt: The console is a single-page JavaScript app
processes.notes: Authentication for engineers is not recorded. CORS origins and credential support are not recorded. WebSocket TLS, handshake authentication, and post-connection session checks are not recorded.

processes.name: Dispatch API
processes.description: The API called by the console and schedule importer for dispatch operations.
processes.source_excerpt: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
processes.notes: The API is not reachable from the internet.

processes.name: Schedule importer
processes.description: A process that pulls and parses the scheduling partner's SOAP feed and posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API.
processes.source_excerpt: Our schedule importer runs on the corporate network.
processes.notes: The importer presents an API token that has not been rotated since it was issued. Partner and importer identification mechanisms are not recorded.

data_stores.name: Dispatch database
data_stores.description: The database containing job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and the token or session that created each job order.
data_stores.source_excerpt: That database holds the job orders, the crew names and the crew mobile numbers.
data_stores.notes: The database's protection at rest is not recorded.

data_stores.name: Schedule archive
data_stores.description: A folder where the importer writes each downloaded scheduling document.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive

data_stores.name: Corporate file store
data_stores.description: The corporate file store containing the schedule archive folder.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a folder on the corporate file store
data_stores.notes: The text does not place the file store in a network zone.

data_flows.name: load console
data_flows.description: A duty engineer loads the dispatch console from the corporate web host.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They open the dispatch console in their browser.

data_flows.name: open console
data_flows.description: A duty engineer opens and uses the dispatch console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They open the dispatch console in their browser.
data_flows.notes: How an engineer signs in is not recorded.

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The dispatch console calls the dispatch API cross-origin.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console calls the dispatch API.
data_flows.notes: The origins allowed by CORS and whether credentials are allowed are not recorded.

data_flows.name: live job status
data_flows.description: The dispatch console maintains a WebSocket to receive live job status from the dispatch API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console also opens a WebSocket to the dispatch API and holds it open for live job status.
data_flows.notes: It is not recorded whether the socket runs over TLS, whether its handshake is authenticated, or whether the engineer's session is checked again after connection.

data_flows.name: read and write database
data_flows.description: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
data_flows.data_description: Job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and creating tokens or sessions

data_flows.name: pull SOAP feed
data_flows.description: The schedule importer pulls the scheduling partner's planned-work feed.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every hour it pulls the partner's SOAP feed over HTTPS
data_flows.notes: How the partner identifies the importer and how the importer identifies the partner are not recorded.
data_flows.data_description: Tomorrow's planned work in an XML document

data_flows.name: write archive
data_flows.description: The schedule importer writes each downloaded XML document into the schedule archive.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive

data_flows.name: post work orders
data_flows.description: The schedule importer posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The importer then posts the parsed work orders to the same dispatch API the console calls.
data_flows.notes: The importer presents an API token. The token was issued when the importer was built and has not been rotated.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where duty engineers and the schedule importer are located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Duty engineers sit on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: Production control plane
trust_boundaries.description: The same-company zone holding the live estate, with authority to move crews and change depot work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The dispatch API runs in the production control plane.
trust_boundaries.notes: A corporate laptop holds none of the control-plane rights, and the control plane is not reachable from the internet.

trust_boundaries.name: Scheduling partner
trust_boundaries.description: The zone controlled by the separate scheduling-partner company.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: A scheduling partner, which is another company

assumptions.assumption: The dispatch database is confidential because it contains job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and tokens or sessions.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database holds job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and the token or session that created each job order.

assumptions.assumption: The schedule archive is confidential because it contains downloaded planned-work documents.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the archive contains each downloaded document from the scheduling partner's planned-work feed.

assumptions.assumption: The corporate file store is confidential because it contains the schedule archive and its planned-work documents.
assumptions.basis: The source describes the schedule archive as a folder on the corporate file store.
